intro: Timor-Leste has about 1.4 million people and one of the youngest populations in Asia.

chapters.title: People and languages
text: Tetum and Portuguese are official languages, Indonesian and English are working languages, and over 30 local languages are spoken. About 97% of people are Catholic, one of the highest shares in the world.

chapters.title: Life
text: Most people live in rural areas and farm. Dili is the capital and largest town.
